subjects.name: Data Structures and Algorithms / Data Structures and Advanced Algorithms
course_outcomes: IOT2101.1: Understand asymptotic notations and explain the operations and applications of fundamental data structures in algorithm design.
IOT2101.2: Apply tree-based and heap-based data structures to solve computational problems.
IOT2101.3: Apply graph algorithms such as traversal techniques, minimum spanning trees, and shortest path algorithms to model and solve real-world problems.

IOT2101.4: Apply dynamic programming and greedy approaches to solve optimization problems, and analyze advanced algorithmic techniques including network flow, string matching, branch and bound, and approximation algorithms.

IOT2101.5: Analyze the time and space complexity of different algorithms using asymptotic notations and evaluate the suitability of data structures and algorithmic approaches for solving specific computational problems.
IOT2101.6: Examine the trade-offs between algorithmic approaches and distinguish between computationally feasible and computationally hard problems.

subjects.name: Computer Networks
course_outcomes: IOT2103.1: Learn the terminology and concepts of the OSI reference model, TCP-IP reference model and the need for the layered architecture.
IOT2103.2: Understand the concepts of protocols, network interfaces, and design/performance issues in local area networks and wide area networks.

IOT2103.6: Synthesize the strength and shortcomings of the underlying protocols, and then go on to hypothesize new and better application layer protocols.

subjects.name: Network Security and Cryptography / Fundamentals of Network Security and Cryptography
course_outcomes: IOT2105.1: Understand the concepts of Cryptography and Network Security including Private and Public key cryptography and various protocols to protect computing system against potential threats.
IOT2105.2: Explore Mathematical techniques for supporting the cryptographic mechanisms.
IOT2105.3: Analyze and compare various cryptographic techniques.
IOT2105.4: Evaluate security mechanisms using rigorous approaches by key ciphers, message authentication and Hash functions.
IOT2105.5: Investigate various network security applications, IPsec, Firewall, IDS, Web Security, Email Security and Malicious software etc.
IOT2105.6: Design a secure network after analyzing the vulnerabilities in any computing system.
